TOM PRITCHARD, NORMAN DEWBERRY and FRANK WEBB who have given such fine sevice on those busy evenings have decided to join the horses from the Brewer's dray and enjoy some gentle running in quiet, green pastures away from that cacophony of sound at Belgrave Hall.

It's May 1929 and the crowds have again turned out in force to watch an athletic meeting put on at Battersea Park Athletic Track by the Belgrave Harriers. The half-mile handicap was a close affair up front with Tom Pritchard just triumphing over Alf Club of Kent A.C., and T.C.
It's good to see Maureen and Brian Pritchard attending our functions. Recently Master Thomas Pritchard (born 11/05/1999) was signed up, making him a fourth generation Belgravian.
My father Thomas Pritchard joined the Club in the 1930’s and in later years became a Life Member of Belgrave so I am especially pleased to carry on the tradition.

The 880 yards handicap featured an entry from none other than Tom Pritchard, father of our current President Brian. And what about this for an unusual athletic event – the Cigarette Race, open to Met.
